about.label: About
about.title: I build things that run on my own hardware.
paragraphs: I’m a self-driven developer who builds things that live in browsers and beyond — gamified fitness apps, real-time audio visualizers, Twitch-powered LED controllers, and production business websites.
When I’m not writing code, I’m exploring new web APIs, tinkering with hardware, or helping local businesses build a stronger online presence.

contact.label: Contact
contact.title: Let’s work together
contact.description: Have a project in mind, need a website built, or just want to talk about something you’re building? Reach out.
